notes.title: Linux Port: Complete!
notes.notes:
I finished the Linux build!
Sorry for the wait as things in my life have been changing. One thing I would appreciate is if ya'lls can test Funmi on the Steam deck / any Linux kernel and let me know if it all works for you!

Furthermore, please let me know your thoughts on the game! It's the only way I can improve the game so yea.

Have a great day!

notes.title: Linux Port: Begins!
notes.notes:
Heyo! I started to write the Linux port today. Major thing that was done was simply making the source file and writing some OpenGL startup code. I've yet tested the code however, as I need to get a good Linux distro on my Raspberry Pi 4 to test it all (so very soon it'll be tested).

This update will probably not effect many people but I still have wanted to make this game cross platform so yea!

Thanks for reading!
